newsitem.title: UK: Tanker and bulker in collision at Ulsan, S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Tanker and bulker in collision at Ulsan, S.Korea.

text.p: The Maltese-flag tanker Tomis Providence was in collision with the Chinese-flag bulker Bao Shan Hai while approaching Ulsan anchorage on July 22, Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service said on Thursday.
The 64,910-dwt bulker was at Ulsan anchorage awaiting a berth when the incident took place.
The 88,850-dwt Tomis Providence sustained damage to its starboard side, while the Bao Shan Hai was damaged in the bow area.
Repairs to both vessels, which are waiting to discharge, have yet to be decided.
No cargo damage or pollution was reported.
